title: Schedule Type Editor polish: smaller cards, per-period clear, quick delete, instant naming
summary: Period time cards in the Schedule Type Editor are noticeably smaller and denser (3 per row instead of 2, tighter padding/type) instead of taking up more room than a start/end time pair needs.

Each card now has its own clear button that actually removes that period's time for this schedule type, instead of relying on blanking both time fields (which previously saved as a bogus ' - ' string rather than truly unsetting it).
The Schedule Types list in Settings now has a Delete button right there for custom types, not just inside the editor.
Creating a new schedule type now jumps straight into the name field, selected and ready to type, instead of leaving it on the 'New Schedule Type' placeholder until you click in.
